name: soulledger
description: SoulLedger monorepo root. Holds the workspace list only; every runnable target lives in a workspace.

_overrides_notes._: npm honours `overrides` only in the package it installs from — for this workspace that is the ROOT, and only this file. frontend/package.json used to carry its own copy; it was inert and read as live. Do not re-add them there.
_overrides_notes.sharp: GHSA on libheif, <0.35.4. next depends on ^0.34.5, so without this pin the advisory stays open however new next gets.
_overrides_notes.@redocly/openapi-core: Its bundled js-yaml sat at 4.3.1, inside the maxTotalMergeKeys advisory range (4.0.0-4.3.1). Nested rather than a flat `js-yaml` pin: @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config needs 3.x, and forcing 4.x on it would break jest coverage.
_overrides_notes.nwsapi: PINNED AT 2.2.23 FOR SPEED, NOT SECURITY — and unpinning costs four minutes per test run. nwsapi is jsdom's CSS selector engine. Measured 2026-09-11 while regenerating this lockfile: at 2.2.27, `dispatchProposeValidation` + `searchSelectIsServerFiltered` took 287s and eight of their tests blew the 5s default timeout; pinned back to 2.2.23 the same two files take 0.93s. That is ~300x, and it is not a hang — with --testTimeout=90000 they pass. A CPU profile put 77% of samples in jsdom `matches` / `ownerDocument` and nwsapi `has` / `matchesNative`, which is what named the package: jsdom itself did not move (26.1.0 both sides). Only these two files are affected because only they render a form whose queries walk a large tree; 110 trivial component tests ran in 1.3s in the same slow install. Before touching this line, run those two files and read the wall time — a green suite with a raised timeout would hide it.
